t: The Wallace Cameron Stericlens Sterile Saline Spray is a professional first aid solution designed for fast wound irrigation and debris removal. This 16 pack is ideal for busy construction sites and trade workshops where rapid injury response is essential. The aerosol system allows application from any angle, even upside down, to access awkward injuries easily. A precise spray cleanses from a distance of 10 to 12cm without direct contact, reducing contamination risks. Each spray remains sterile even after opening, providing a reliable and long-lasting resource for general purpose first aid.
